name: Media writers and readers
description: The suite's one media I/O: AVFoundation and ImageIO behind SuiteModel's MediaEncoding and MediaDecoding. MovieWriter writes H.264, HEVC, HEVC with alpha and ProRes 4444 movies tagged BT.709, the canonical copy of Halo's movie writer.
technology: Swift 6, AVFoundation, VideoToolbox and CoreGraphics, macOS 26
